newsitem.title: CHINA: China buys two 747 airliners from Boeing Co.
newsitem.headline: China buys two 747 airliners from Boeing Co.

text.p: China has bought two 747-400 airliners from Boeing Co for $380 million, an official of the China Aviation Supplies Corp told Reuters shortly before a signing ceremony on Thursday.
Each airliner is powered by four Pratt and Whitney engines, a subsidiary of United Technologies Corp, said the official who declined to be identified.
The planes will be delivered in 1999, apparently for use by Air China, China's national carrier, he said.
In July last year, the state-run China Air Supplies Corp bought three 747-400s. The latest purchase brought the value of Boeing's sales to China under two contracts to about $900 million.
